string-array.name: eye_tips
string-array.item: Look at something at least 6 metres (20 feet) away for 20 seconds.
Blink slowly 10 times to refresh and moisten your eyes.
Close your eyes and relax your face, jaw and shoulders.
Roll your eyes slowly: up, right, down, left — then the other way.
Rub your palms until warm and cup them gently over your closed eyes.
Look out of a window and focus on the farthest point you can see.
Focus on your finger close to your face, then on something far away. Repeat 5 times.
Stand up, stretch your back and neck, and drink a glass of water.

Some phones turn accessibility services off after a restart. With this one-time permission the app turns its service back on by itself.

1. Enable USB debugging and connect the phone to a computer.
2. Run this command once:

%1$s

Without it, you get a notification after a restart and can turn it back on with one tap.
Android turned the accessibility service off (e.g. after a restart, or because Advanced Protection is on). Blocking and eye care do not work until it is on again — tap to turn it on.

The firewall uses the Android VpnService to create a local VPN on your device. Traffic of the apps you choose is routed into this local VPN and refused, so those apps have no internet.\n\nNo traffic is sent to any server, nothing is inspected, logged, collected or shared. All other apps connect to the internet directly as usual.

For the notification digest, Social Blocker+ reads the notifications of other apps (app name, title, text and time), removes them from the notification shade and shows them together in one summary notification.\n\nThis data stays only on your device, is deleted automatically every day and is never sent to a server or shared. Calls, alarms and media notifications are not touched.

Activating device admin only prevents this app from being uninstalled while it is active. It is your own choice and helps you keep your commitment.\n\nThe app uses no device-admin policies (it cannot lock, wipe or change your phone) and collects no data. You can deactivate it in Settings › Device admin apps when blocking is off.
